{{Top|leg}}
The '''Wartaki Islands''' were an archipelago<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|321}}</ref> located near the coastline on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. The [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]]'' native to the islands were the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]]'' primary speakers of [[Xaczik/Legends|Xaczik]].<ref name="Rebel Dawn">''[[Rebel Dawn]]''</ref>
